theorem lg_target {α : Type u_2} [Field α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] : Archimedean α := by
  constructor
  intro x
  intro h
  by_contra h'
  let s := { n • h | n : ℕ }
  have : ∃ s', s' = sup s := sup_exists
  rcases this with ⟨s', rfl⟩
  have this : (sup s : α) ≤ x := le_supr (fun n => n • h) h'
  rw [le_supr] at this
  apply le_antisymm
  exact h
  exact this
